exposure: Localization of IUA (fundus, corpus, isthmus, cornu)
Infertility group (women with IUA and uterine factor-related infertility)
Pregnancy group (pregnant women with IUA who had a live birth via cesarean section at term)
finding: Fundal and dense-type intrauterine adhesions are associated with uterine factor-related infertility, while isthmus-located and film-type adhesions may not be.
